page_title: HEI 0-2 MAI | Heidenheim v Mainz 16/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+2' Mainz quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Mainz work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Mainz have been awarded a corner kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
89' Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot towards the middle of the net, but Robin Zentner is alert and denies him.
88' The corner is swung in but Mainz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
88' Mainz show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The referee signals a corner kick to Mainz.
84' A cross from a corner kick by Heidenheim is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
84' 55:45 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
81' Paul Wanner (Heidenheim) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Zentner comes off his line to gather the ball.
80' Frank Schmidt prepares a substitution. Jan Schoppner is replaced by Luca Kerber (Heidenheim).
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Nadiem Amiri walks off the pitch to be replaced by Lennard Maloney (Mainz).
79' Substitution. Dominik Kohr will be replaced by Andreas Hanche-Olsen (Mainz).
79' Bo Henriksen has decided to substitute Anthony Caci and he is replaced by Silvan Widmer (Mainz).
75' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Felix Brych signals. That's a free kick to Mainz.
74' The resulting corner from Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) is cleared by the defence.
74' Heidenheim are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. It will be a corner kick for Heidenheim.
73' Today's referee Felix Brych rightly decides to book Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) for his harsh tackle.
71' Bo Henriksen has decided to make a change. Armindo Sieb (Mainz) replaces Nelson Weiper.
71' Anthony Caci (Mainz) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Felix Brych didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
70' Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee.
68' Substitution. Julian Niehues (Heidenheim) has come on for Frans Kratzig.
66' The fouls committed statistics – 4:6.
65' The foul by Dominik Kohr (Mainz) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Felix Brych.
63' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Heidenheim, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
62' Bo Henriksen has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Jae-Sung Lee (Mainz) replacing Jonathan Burkardt.
62' Felix Brych shows a yellow card to Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim) for a tough tackle.
59' Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
57' We are about to witness a subsitution. Leo Scienza (Heidenheim) for Jonas Fohrenbach.
56' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Heidenheim.
56' Wonderful movement by Heidenheim. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
53' Heidenheim can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

52' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) releases a powerful first-time effort from the edge of the box which goes in the direction of the crossbar, but the keeper leaps like a salmon to deny him. Excellent goalkeeping! The linesman makes the right call and Heidenheim will have a corner.
52' Heidenheim have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' 12:6 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The shots on goal statistics – 3:5.
49' 0 - 2 Goal! Jonathan Burkardt puts the ball on the head of Nelson Weiper (Mainz), who has the easy task to score into an empty net. 0:2.

48' Mainz slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
46' Frank Schmidt decides to make a substitution. Adrian Beck will be replaced by Paul Wanner (Heidenheim).
46' Thomas Keller comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marvin Pieringer (Heidenheim).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
42' Heidenheim showcase their great team work by exchanging one-two passes, but one wayward pass sees them lose possession. It's a throw-in for Mainz.

40' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mainz.
39' Heidenheim quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
38' Paul Nebel (Mainz) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the middle of the goal was easily saved by Kevin Muller.
34' Mainz seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
31' Kaishu Sano (Mainz) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
28' 0 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Anthony Caci sprays a pass out to Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz), and he has an easy job to slot the ball into an empty net. The score is 0:1.
27' Jonathan Burkardt (Mainz) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
26' A corner kick by Heidenheim is thwarted by the well prepared Robin Zentner (Mainz).

25' Mathias Honsak (Heidenheim) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the left post. Robin Zentner is alert and denies him with a nice save. The linesman points to the corner flag, Heidenheim are going to take it.

24' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Mainz are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
20' Felix Brych blows the whistle, Thomas Keller (Heidenheim) is penalised for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Mainz.
19' Phillipp Mwene (Mainz) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Heidenheim.
18' Omar Haktab Traore (Heidenheim) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
16' Nadiem Amiri (Mainz) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
16' Nelson Weiper (Mainz) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out for a corner. Mainz can continue in their attacking effort.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Heidenheim.

13' Heidenheim are happy to keep the ball as they wait for gaps in defence to open up. However, an opposing player steps in and clears. The ball is out of play. Heidenheim will have a chance to score from a corner.
13' Tim Siersleben (Heidenheim) smashes the ball from the edge of the box and misses well wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Mainz will have a goal kick.
12' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.

11' Heidenheim show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted. The ball goes out of play. Heidenheim are awarded a corner kick.
7' Frans Kratzig (Heidenheim) commits a rough challenge and Felix Brych blows his whistle for a foul.
3' Heidenheim are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
